==Description==
The '''Vampire''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. It had less health than the [[Demon (Nightmare Carnival)|Demon]], while walking at the same speed as it. However, upon its death, the '''Vampire''' transformed into the [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]], which is considerably faster than the '''Vampire'''.

The '''Vampire''' could have been spawned by [[Jack O' Bot]].

==Appearance==
The '''Vampire''' wore a red, yellow and black tuxedo, and also wore a black cape. It wore a bat tie with a large spike collar. It had black pants and its skin was completely white. It had a {{RLinkC|29532363|Vampire}} face and black hair.

==Strategy==
*While the '''Vampire''' has somewhat high health, its main threat is the [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]] it spawns.
**The [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]] is considerably faster than the '''Vampire''' and cannot collide with [[units]], such as the [[Military Base]]'s [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]] and [[Railgun Tank]].
*If a '''Vampire''' has low health and is near the end of the map, try not to kill it as it will transform into a [[Bat (Nightmare Carnival)|Bat]] and do considerably more damage to the base.
*A couple of [[Ranger|Outlaws]] and [[Minigunner]]s should be placed down prior to the debut of the '''Vampire''' in order to deal with them.
**Additionally, [[Commander]] should also be used in order to boost these towers' firerate.

==Trivia==
*Vampires, in a fictitious context, are known to transform into bats at their pleasure. They do not turn into bats upon their death.
